svg.title: GitHub public contributions
svg.desc: Isometric public commit calendar from 04 Nov 2025 to 03 Nov 2026. 365 dated cells include zero-count days; 547 contributions across 67 active days. Cell height is linear within this snapshot, at 1.27118644068 SVG units per contribution, with a maximum bar height of 75 units. Source scope: GitHub GraphQL contribution-calendar days visible to the public; the request uses no read:user scope and does not request restricted-contribution fields. Aggregate counts do not measure work quality or intensity.
svg.text: Data through 03 Nov 2026 · 547 contributions across 67 active days; 365 dated days.

Source scope: GitHub GraphQL contribution-calendar days visible to the public; the request uses no read:user scope and does not request restricted-contribution fields. All 365 dated cells are shown, including zeros; totals do not measure work quality or intensity.
Linear within this snapshot: 1.27118644068 SVG units per contribution; maximum bar 75 units. Exact counts appear in each cell description.
